_note: Magic parity fixture (01-09): four independent scenarios exercising castSpell (a damage spell in a forced encounter, and a heal outside combat), drinkPotion, and readScroll. Seeds were found by a throwaway discovery script (engine-only, cross-checked for prototype parity before being committed here — same method 01-05/01-07/01-08 used) that scanned seeds 1-5000 via newRun(seed) for a Magic User whose rolled grimoire/scrolls made each scenario reachable at level 1: seed 8 is an Illusionist with Freeze in its grimoire (a lvl-1 offense spell, thrown kind); seed 7 is a Wizard with Heal in its grimoire and a scroll on hand. `castSpell` requires an `idx` field (the spell's index into content/spells.js's SPELLS array, matching engine/actions.js's castSpell.idx validation); `drinkPotion`/`readScroll` take no extra fields. `startCombat` is not in engine/actions.js's validated ACTION_TYPES (an internal function other rule domains call) -- see test/parity/combat-parity.test.js's header for why the harness special-cases it. Phase 23 Plan 04 (FID-06): the `cast-damage` scenario now carries a `divergence` record — Freeze pays out via killFoe, a deliberate rules change.

divergence.rationale: Freeze pays out (user decision 2026-09-14) — the prototype's thrown branch marked a frozen foe dead without calling killFoe, so a Freeze kill awarded no experience, coin, treasure roll, kill count, or ration; the engine now routes the kill through killFoe after emitting frozenSolid. Seed 8's Illusionist freezes the Shriek on a d10 roll of 1 (a hit), so this is the one parity scenario that now pays out where the prototype did not. killFoe's four draws (d6 sp roll, d10 coin roll, d20 treasure check, Beasts cooking d6) happen after the last compared action in this scenario, so no earlier draw position moves — items/wp/level and combat-null-on-both-sides are unchanged.
